An '''Impulse Converter''' was a component used in [[Crozo Industrial Products/Legends|Crozo Industrial Products']] [[At-cyb husher mike]]. The component was located in the part of the implant that was surgically implanted into an individual's throat near the [[Larynx/Legends|larynx]]. It worked alongside the [[Vibration Chamber]], [[Vibration Meter]], and [[Vocalizer Transmitter]] to transmit subvocalized messages.<ref name="EGWT" />
